title: Enterprise resource planning (ERP)
label: TIKTOK SHOP · DEVELOPER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-07-06
html:
What ERP apps do

Enterprise resource planning (ERP) apps connect TikTok Shop with a seller's back-office operating system. A typical ERP integration supports shop authorization, product and inventory management, order synchronization, fulfillment coordination, financial reconciliation, and, when applicable, return and refund workflows. Use this page when your app is broader than a Connector and needs to coordinate multiple seller operation workflows. If your app only connects TikTok Shop with one or more commerce channels, start with the Connector or MCA requirements. If your app only reconciles settlements and payments, start with the Accounting and Finance requirements.

App type Primary purpose Typical TikTok Shop coverage
Connector or MCA Connect TikTok Shop with external commerce channels. Shop connection, category mapping, product listing, inventory and price sync, order sync, and fulfillment.
ERP Connect TikTok Shop with the seller's back-office operating system. Connector baseline plus inventory operations, order operations, fulfillment, finance, and optional returns.
Accounting and Finance Reconcile settlements, payments, withdrawals, and order-level or SKU-level transactions. Shop connection and finance APIs only, unless the app also works as an ERP or Connector.

Use case maintenance note

Several ERP use cases are shared with the Connector, MCA, Dropshipping, POD, and Accounting categories. To avoid duplicated rules drifting across pages, treat Partner Center, the latest ARD template, and the category-specific requirement page as the source of truth for the shared baseline. This ERP page summarizes how those shared modules apply to ERP apps and lists ERP-specific grouping by workflow and scope.

Shared module Canonical reference ERP usage
Shop connection, category, listing, order, and fulfillment Connector, multi-channel, dropshipping, and print on demand ERP apps usually implement this baseline when they connect seller systems to TikTok Shop catalog, inventory, order, or fulfillment workflows.
Finance Accounting and Finance ERP apps implement these use cases when they include settlement, payment, withdrawal, or transaction reconciliation.
Returns and refunds Return and Refund API references in Partner Center ERP apps implement these use cases when sellers manage post-sales operations in the ERP.

Scope summary

Apply for the smallest set of scopes needed for the use cases your ERP actually supports. In Partner Center, go to App & Service > Manage > Manage API and search by scope name and package ID.

Scope package Used by Required for a minimum ERP launch?
Shop Authorized Information(431812)
Global Shop Information(431300)		 Shop authorization, authorized shop lookup, shop connection lifecycle, and carrier mapping. Yes, if the ERP connects seller shops.
Global Product Information(431108)
Product Basic(430148)
Product Modify(431492)
Product Delete & Recover(431428)		 Category mapping, listing prerequisites, product listing, product search, inventory sync, price sync, and product edits. Yes, if the ERP manages products, inventory, or price.
Product Optimization(729604) SEO keyword recommendations, listing diagnostics, and white-background image optimization. Yes, if the ERP implements product information quality use cases.
Order Information(430276) Order import, order status sync, order detail lookup, fulfillment coordination, and returns. Yes, if the ERP syncs orders or handles post-sales operations.
Fulfillment Basic(430340) 3PL/4PL fulfillment flows, shipment updates, order splitting, order combination, and return logistics. Yes, if the ERP handles fulfillment or returns.
Finance Information(430596) Payment, statement, withdrawal, statement transaction, and order transaction reconciliation. Yes, if the ERP includes finance or settlement reconciliation.

Finance

Finance use cases use the Finance Information(430596) scope. Keep them grouped separately from product, order, and fulfillment scopes so developers can decide whether their ERP includes settlement or payment reconciliation.

Use case ID Required Summary Scopes Integration guide
FIN-GET-PAYMENT Yes Retrieve seller payment data on TikTok Shop to reconcile payments with the seller's bank account. Finance Information(430596) Finance API overview
FIN-GET-STATEMENT Yes Retrieve statement records for a specified date range. Statements are settled on a daily basis. Finance Information(430596) Get Statements
FIN-GET-WITHDRAWALS No Optionally retrieve seller withdrawal records to confirm they align with payment records. Finance Information(430596) Finance API overview
FIN-TXGET-STATEMENT Yes Retrieve transactions by statement_id to get the orders included in a statement. Finance Information(430596) Get Statement Transactions
FIN-TXGET-ORDER Yes Retrieve transactions by order ID, including SKU-level transaction details. Finance Information(430596) Get Order Statement Transactions

Returns and refunds

Return, refund, and replacement use cases are optional for ERP apps unless your submitted app scope includes post-sales operations. Implement the rows that match the seller workflows your app exposes, and keep the Order Information(430276) and Fulfillment Basic(430340) scopes grouped with the return feature rather than with the minimum product or finance baseline.
